title: Payment-processor + card-network financial censorship - the private speech chokepoint
source: Public record: Visa/Mastercard adult-content merchant rules (2020-21); OnlyFans Aug-2021 reversal; Pornhub/MindGeek card cutoff (Dec 2020, post-NYT Kristof); Backpage (2015); PayPal 2022 AUP episode; NCOSE campaigns; Operation Choke Point (1.0 + crypto 2.0). Overlay on the control-apparatus + Digital-ID threads (structural; no financial-core edges). HONESTY: the actions + dates = fact; 'censorship' vs 'harm-reduction / legal-compliance / brand + chargeback risk' is CONTESTED - both framings presented; the 'this is a distinct control mechanism NOT reducible to the EA/AI networks' point is a labeled competing-explanation hypothesis.

edges.notes: Visa + Mastercard (~80% of US card volume) set Acceptable-Use / brand-risk rules that function as a near-universal chokepoint: a merchant cut off by both is effectively de-monetized. Networks cite illegal content, trafficking, chargeback fraud + brand risk; critics call it private financial censorship of LEGAL speech (fact of the duopoly power; framing contested).

Mastercard's 2021 'special merchant registration' rules for adult content (age/consent documentation) tightened the lever; defended as anti-CSAM/trafficking, criticized as pushing legal adult work off-platform (fact of the policy; effect + motive contested).

Visa suspended Pornhub/MindGeek acceptance (Dec 2020, after a NYT column alleged CSAM) + was named in related litigation; part of the pattern of card action against adult platforms (fact of the suspension; underlying-harm claims + scope contested).

NCOSE (National Center on Sexual Exploitation; ex-Morality in Media) + allied anti-trafficking/faith groups run sustained campaigns pressuring card networks + processors to cut adult platforms - the activist->processor pressure channel (fact of the campaigns; whether it is child-protection or morality-driven speech-suppression is contested).

The clearest case: OnlyFans announced an adult-content BAN (Aug 2021) then REVERSED it days later, citing that it had 'secured assurances' from banking/payment partners - i.e. payment pressure nearly killed a legal business overnight (fact).

PayPal/Stripe have de-platformed adult creators, firearms sellers, and some political/press accounts; PayPal's Oct-2022 AUP briefly added a $2,500 fine for 'misinformation' before walking it back after backlash - the processor-as-speech-arbiter flashpoint (fact).

Same chokepoint logic applied to whole disfavored INDUSTRIES via banks/processors: Operation Choke Point (2013, firearms/payday) + the alleged crypto 'Choke Point 2.0' (2023-25 debanking) - regulatory pressure on intermediaries to cut lawful sectors (fact of the debate; coordinated-intent contested; ties the existing node).

CONVERGENCE: payment rails + identity are merging - age/ID-verification mandates (UK OSA, adult-site laws) route through processors + ID vendors, so the FINANCIAL chokepoint and the IDENTITY chokepoint reinforce each other (interpretation, labeled; cf the age-verification + Digital-ID threads).

COMPETING-EXPLANATION NOTE: chokepoint-via-intermediary (processor / host / registrar / app-store) is a DISTINCT control mechanism that can explain de-platforming + pressure activity NOT reducible to the EA / AI-safety networks - one of several parallel, overlapping explanatory frames (state law, financial chokepoints, influence ops, activist campaigns). The map holds these as competing hypotheses, not one unified cabal (interpretation, labeled).
